test_title: PYST 06: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 11 Dec 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

My aunt said that they had shifted to a new house.

options.text: "We have shifted to a new house," said my aunt.
"We will be shifting to a new house," said my aunt.
"We are shifting to a new house," said my aunt.
"I am shifting to a new house," said my aunt.

solution:
```html
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** His angry mother jeered and asked whether he supposed that he knew better than his own father.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"whether he supposed that he knew" becomes "Do you suppose you know"**
 
 
• Indirect question "whether he supposed" is converted to direct question "Do you suppose."
 
• Pronoun "he" is changed to "you" to match direct speech.
 
• Verb "knew" is changed to "know" to match the present tense in direct questions.
 
 
 
• **"his own father" remains "your own father"**
 
 
• Possessive pronoun "his" is converted to "your" to match the direct speech pronoun change.
 
 
 
• **Reporting verb:**
 
 
• Indirect: "jeered and asked"
 
• Converted to: "jeered," maintaining the mocking tone.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• Starts with a capital letter "Do" and ends with a question mark "?".
 
• Reporting clause follows the quoted speech, starting with a lowercase letter after the comma.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"“Do you suppose you know better than your own father?” jeered his angry mother."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** "Her mother jeeringly expressed, 'He doesn’t know better than his own father.'" 
 
 
• Original sentence changes from a question to a statement.
 
• Loses the mocking jeering context.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** “Her mother supposed, 'He knew better than his own father.'" 
 
 
• Tense and context incorrect: changes the meaning to a past affirmative thought instead of a present question.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "Do you know better than your father I suppose” jeered his angry mother.” 
 
 
• Word order and punctuation incorrect, results in unclear and altered meaning.
 
 

``
